name: zoomie-lint
description: Extremely fast linting with rules written in .zlint

zlint.path.description: Path to the zlint binary. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Empty: use the newest target/{release,debug}/zlint build in the workspace, else zlint from PATH.

zlint.scanWorkspace.description: Lint every file in the workspace in the background, streaming results as files finish. When off, only open files are linted.

zlint.inspectHover.description: For writing rules: hovering in a linted file shows the zlint layers at the cursor, the field each sits in, and the native facts (type, resolved, ...) there.
